```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)  # for color functions
library(dplyr)
```

```{r read.data}
metabs_betas = read.csv("rh_metabs_betas.csv")
q_values = read.csv("rh_metabs_qs.csv")

rownames(metabs_betas) = metabs_betas$CHEMICAL_NAME
metabs_betas$CHEMICAL_NAME <- NULL

rownames(q_values) = q_values$CHEMICAL_NAME
q_values$CHEMICAL_NAME <- NULL
```


```{r sort.rename.cols}
metabs_betas_sorted <- metabs_betas[order(metabs_betas[, "abx_three"],
                                            decreasing = TRUE), ]

rename_vec <-  c(
    abx_three = "Antibiotics 0 - 3 mo.",
    abx_twelve = "Antibiotics 3 - 12 mo."
  )

colnames(metabs_betas_sorted) <- recode(colnames(metabs_betas_sorted),
                                         !!!rename_vec)
```


```{r set.up.significance}
# Significance annotation logic
stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  if (p < 0.1)  return("#")
  return("")
}
```


## Set up for heatmap

```{r, define.color.columns}
beta_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), c("blue", "white", "red")) #"#FFF0F5"

beta_cols <- c("Antibiotics 0 - 3 mo.",
               "Antibiotics 3 - 12 mo.")

beta_matrix <- as.matrix(metabs_betas_sorted[, beta_cols])
rownames(beta_matrix) <- rownames(metabs_betas_sorted)
q_matrix <- as.matrix(q_values)
qval_mat <- q_matrix[rownames(beta_matrix), ]
```

```{r heatmap.plot, fig.height=8, fig.width=7}
# Plot heatmap with split and color legend
ht_beta <- Heatmap(beta_matrix,
                   name = "Beta coefficient",
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(
                     title = "Beta coefficient",
                     title_position = "leftcenter-rot"),
                   col = beta_col_fun,
                   na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                   column_names_rot = 45,
                   column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                   column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   cluster_columns = FALSE,
                   show_row_names = TRUE, 
                   row_names_side = "left", 
                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                   height = unit(nrow(metabs_betas_sorted) * 5, "mm"),
                   width = unit(30, "mm"),
                   rect_gp = gpar(col = "#696969", lwd = 1),
                   cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- qval_mat[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, col = "black"))}
                   )

ht_beta 
```
